question: How does qualification differ across the graded Shaiva scriptural domains?
premises: Those outside the Shaiva preparation are not qualified in the Shaiva scripture.
Shaivas qualified at one level are not thereby qualified in the left sphere.
Those of the left and right spheres are not thereby qualified in the Kula doctrine or the Trika.
inference: Qualification is graded and does not automatically transfer upward across scriptural domains.
plain_english: They are not qualified in the Shaiva scripture; Shaivas are not qualified in the left sphere; those are not qualified in the right; and those are not qualified in the Kula doctrine or in the Trika.
